name: 金庸群侠传2013_服务器版
english_name: The Story of Hero (2013 Server Edition)
english_description: Another archive in the same architecture family as this project's jyqxc and jyqxc2 (a 2013 server-side release) — most of its file content differs, but the overall structure and known bug surface are essentially the same. Unlike jyqxc2's relationship to jyqxc, a file-by-file diff confirmed this is a genuinely independent snapshot rather than a byte-identical duplicate, with its own unique bugs including a stray angle-bracket #include path that once crashed every score command.
